direction: Date-and-place card. Exterior of St Dochdwy's church, Llandough, in late-October afternoon light. The church is the newly rebuilt Victorian building with fresh grey stone and a clean slate roof. Damp churchyard, fallen leaves, wooded hillside beyond and the Ely valley falling away inland. A slow push in toward the vestry door, where lamplight shows at a small window. No dialogue; wind and rooks only.
